# H&CO LLP

> > A Miami-based global CPA and advisory firm specializing in international tax, global expansion, and digital transformation solutions across 40+ countries.

H&CO is a full-service accounting and consulting firm that combines traditional CPA services with modern technology solutions. The firm serves multinational corporations, startups, and high-net-worth individuals with expertise in cross-border tax planning, entity management, and business process automation.

## Key Topics

- International Tax Planning
- Global Expansion
- Transfer Pricing
- Entity Management
- Latin America
- SAP Business One
- ERP Implementation
- CRM & Automation
- Tax Compliance
- Nearshore Outsourcing
- Family Office Services
- Real Estate Accounting
- Audit & Assurance
- Cloud Solutions
- Digital Transformation

## Core Services

- [Global Expansion Services](https://www.hco.com/global-expansion): H&CO global expansion services across 40+ countries for business setup
- [International Tax Services](https://www.hco.com/international-taxes): H&CO international tax services for corporations and expat tax planning
- [Global Outsourcing Services](https://www.hco.com/global-outsourcing): H&CO global outsourcing for accounting, tax, and entity management
- [Transfer Pricing Services](https://www.hco.com/tax/transfer-pricing): H&CO transfer pricing services for multinational corporations and compliance
- [International Directory](https://www.hco.com/tax/international-desk): H&CO international directory with offices in 29+ countries worldwide

## Specialized Advisory

- [Real Estate Accounting](https://www.hco.com/tax/real-estate-accounting): H&CO real estate accounting for foreign investors with tax planning
- [Family Office Services](https://www.hco.com/tax/family-office): H&CO family office services for wealth management and estate planning
- [Audit & Assurance Services](https://www.hco.com/international-taxes/audit-assurance): H&CO audit and assurance services for construction and financial compliance

## Technology Solutions

- [SAP Business One ERP](https://www.hco.com/sap-business-one): H&CO SAP Business One ERP implementation for SMBs in Latin America
- [Creatio CRM Platform](https://www.hco.com/sap-business-one/creatio): H&CO Creatio no-code CRM platform for business process automation
- [Monday.com Integration](https://www.hco.com/monday): H&CO Monday.com platinum partner for project and workflow management
- [Cloud Solutions](https://www.hco.com/sap-business-one/cloud-solutions): H&CO cloud solutions and SAP Business One cloud infrastructure management
- [H&CO Technology Solutions](https://www.hco.com/solutions-hco-tecnologia): H&CO technology solutions: SAP Business One, Creatio, and digital transformation
